saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ής Μαρτίου — «Αγία Ευβουλή»

attestations.note: One sentence: «Η Αγία Ευβουλή ήταν μητέρα του Άγιου Παντελεήμονα (βλέπε 27 Ιουλίου) και απεβίωσε ειρηνικά» — she was the mother of St Panteleimon, whose day it puts at 27 July, and she died peacefully. The page's Greek form of her name is Ευβουλή; it gives no year, no place, no relic and no hymn. The line itself carries no epithet, and the motherhood is the whole of the identification, which is what this folder's display name already says.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
